changelog:
- Initial release of ffagen__minimax-vision-scraper.
- Combines Playwright webpage screenshots with MiniMax visual language model for advanced scraping.
- Bypasses anti-bot mechanisms by using screenshots and AI image understanding instead of parsing HTML.
- Supports command-line usage and flexible prompts for detail extraction.
- Includes built-in stealth technologies adapted from playwright-scraper-skill to evade detection.
- Provides preset environment variable options and usage instructions for OpenClaw integration.
summary: Playwright截图 + MiniMax图像理解的高级网页抓取skill。绕过反爬虫，直接用AI理解截图内容。
